DESIGN.md engine — runtime integration (Phase 1b)

This fixture embeds a DESIGN.md block. On boot, amvcp-runtime.js parses it, resolves the tokens for the active theme, and applies every --vc-* custom property to :root.

The dev-browser test drives the engine via the window.__veDesignMd hook: hot-swap a second DESIGN.md, toggle the theme, drive the schema-generated controller pad, and round-trip an Export.
